metadata.title: Vibrant 3D Cartoon Character with Concentric Rainbow Background

recipe.visualDefinition: A highly saturated 3D character with exaggerated features, featuring multi-colored rainbow hair and skin covered in black-ink tattoos. The character emerges from a series of concentric, layered rainbow rings that create a tunnel-like depth effect. The aesthetic blends 'Rubber Hose' cartoon eyes with modern 3D clay-like rendering.
coreVisualRelationships: The character's rainbow hair mirrors the color sequence of the background rings.
The high-gloss metallic shark pendant contrasts against the matte skin texture.
The dark, simple tattoos provide a graphic counterpoint to the complex color palette.
The concentric circles draw the eye inward to the character's face.
coreInvariants: Multi-colored hair strands in primary and secondary hues
Large oval black eyes with white highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally located, occupying the middle 60% of the frame, appearing to lean out of the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The character's face, specifically the large black eyes and the bright rainbow teeth.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular movement following the background rings, leading to the central figure, then down to the metallic pendant.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with vibrant color and geometric patterns.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Rainbow spectrum (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple) used in equal distribution.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black used for tattoos, eyes, and shadows to provide definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Chrome/Silver for the chain and shark pendant to add a high-specular highlight.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation across all hues with soft, diffused 3D lighting creating gentle shadows.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Text following the curvature of the face and limbs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mix of numeric symbols and short block text to mimic traditional tattoo flash.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the subculture aesthetic of the character design.
Provides legibility for numeric elements on the forehead.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D render of a character with rainbow hair and rainbow teeth emerging from a tunnel of concentric rainbow-colored rings. The character should have a matte skin texture and wear a large chrome shark pendant on a thick silver chain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply black ink-style tattoos including numbers and small icons onto the character's face and arms, ensuring they follow the 3D geometry of the body.

verificationChecks: Are the background rings perfectly concentric?
Is the hair composed of distinct, vibrant color strands?
Does the chrome pendant have realistic reflections?
Are the tattoos rendered as if they are part of the skin texture?

mustRedesign: Specific facial tattoos to avoid trademarked logos
Unique character features to ensure original IP
postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth gradients in the 3D lighting.
Ensure the 'teeth' colors are distinct and bright.
Verify the depth effect created by the concentric rings.
Confirm the metallic chain looks heavy and reflective.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine 1930s cartoon facial features with modern 3D street-art aesthetics, framed by high-contrast geometric color patterns.
